blindness_and_access.hash_verification: After evaluation and escrow release, verify SHA-256 of the exact sealed file bytes against sealed_E_star_hash before scoring.
blindness_and_access.important_limitation: Hash commitment proves later file integrity relative to this commitment, not that the planted truth is scientifically valid or that evaluator blindness was enforced by access controls.
blindness_and_access.public_evaluator_package_excludes: sealed_E_star.json and all explicit E_star membership fields

B_hash.target: probe_suite_B.json exact bytes, UTF-8, compact JSON, final newline

sealed_E_star_hash.target: organizer-only sealed_E_star.json exact bytes, UTF-8, indented JSON, final newline

metrics.aggregation: Report per-run metrics, then system-template means and architecture means. Do not pool raw TP/FP/FN across architectures without also reporting the per-template estimates.
metrics.bootstrap_CI: For each run, draw 10,000 stratified bootstrap resamples of probe IDs with replacement, sampling 25 from OBJECTIVE_FOCUSED and 25 from CONSTRAINT_FOCUSED within each replicate. Refit the M1 estimator on each resample, compare its E_hat to sealed E_star, and report the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the rho bootstrap distribution as a 95% percentile CI.
metrics.missing_or_failed_run: Record as FAILED/NOT_ESTIMATED; do not impute an E_hat or silently omit the run from counts.
metrics.precision: |E_hat intersect E_star| / |E_hat|; define as 0 when E_hat is empty.
metrics.rho: 1 - ||P_Estar - P_Ehat||_F / ||P_Estar||_F, where each projector is the 16x16 diagonal coordinate projector for the stated variable set. Do not clip rho; values may be negative.

preregistration_scope: Ground-truth commitment, public probe suite, zero-ablation operator, architecture allocation, sample/run counts, estimands, threshold, and bootstrap procedure are frozen before any independent M1 evaluation.
synthetic_setup_status: Prepared. Oracle-style reference observations have been generated for the public probe suite; no M1 evaluator run, model-estimated E_hat, metric score, or acceptance decision has been executed.

tau.acceptance_use: Report threshold pass/fail separately from precision, recall, and rho; do not treat this criterion as proof of broader system correctness.
tau.clarification: The request did not specify the construction/normalization of v_S or aggregation across B; the formula above freezes those details for reproducibility without exposing E_star.
tau.operational_definition: For each probe i, define d_i[j] = y_i.objective - y_i^(A_j).objective for each of the 16 single-variable zero-ablation responses. Let v_S,i = d_i / ||d_i||_2 when ||d_i||_2 > 1e-12, otherwise v_S,i = 0. For an estimated coordinate set E_hat, P_Ehat is its 16x16 diagonal coordinate projector. The tau error is RMS_i(||P_Ehat v_S,i - v_S,i||_2) over all 50 probes. The frozen threshold criterion is tau_error <= 0.1.
